cited_evidence: In upstream_demand_provenance.py, assemble_provenance appends "record_id": record.get('source_id', "") while also setting "source_id": record.get("source_id", "").
The observed Job-2 input evidence_sources contains record_id values s01 through s08, while the needs and coverage records use record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08.
In downstream_coverage_priority.py, prioritize builds rank_by_record_id from evidence_sources_df["record_id"] and looks up rank_by_record_id.get(coverage.get("record_id", ""), 0).
The observed Job-2 priorities all have "upstream_rank": 0, showing the provenance rank handoff did not match any downstream need record_id.
initial_receipt.explanation: The two-job execution contains a provenance handoff fault. Job 1's assemble_provenance builds evidence_sources with record_id set to the source_id, producing records like record_id 's01' instead of the need record_id 'n06-r01'. Job 2 then cannot match evidence_sources to coverage records by record_id, so every priority row has upstream_rank 0. This violates preserving exact upstream-to-downstream provenance and preserving upstream provenance order for ranking.
